## Draftava 1.4.0
A smoother project workflow, with V2 project storage and switching.
- Open or create V2 projects in user-selected locations, including iCloud Drive. - Convert an existing V1 project into a separate V2 copy while preserving the original. - Keep readable project folder names and handle duplicate names automatically. - Remove inactive projects from the recent-project list without deleting their files. - Keep removed projects off the list after restarting Draftava. - Restore typing sounds when editing in V2 projects. - Preserve existing V1 project compatibility and recovery safeguards.
Your original V1 project is not deleted during conversion.
